support.title: How can we
support.lead: Questions about your event, a payment or your account? Email us and a real person replies.
support.reply: We usually reply within one working day.
support.faq: Do guests need an app?::No. Guests scan the QR code and upload from their phone's browser. The app is optional, mainly for hosts.|How long are photos kept?::Free events keep photos for 30 days, One Day for 1 year and Big Day for 3 years. You can download everything at any time.|Can I get a refund?::Yes. Paid plans come with a 14-day money-back guarantee. Email us from the address you signed up with.|Who can see the photos?::Only the hosts and co-hosts see the full album. Guests see the shared feed, and you can approve shots first.
